allow:
Bash(echo "=== Pages that exist ===" &&
echo "it-it/costiera-amalfitana:" && ls dist/it-it/costiera-amalfitana/ &&
echo "" &&
echo "de-de/strande:" && ls dist/de-de/strande/ 2>/dev/null | head -5)

Bash(echo "=== Checking de-de Sorrentine Peninsula folder ===" &&
echo "" &&
echo "sorrentiner-halbinsel:" && ls dist/de-de/strande/sorrentiner-halbinsel/ &&
echo "" &&
echo "sorrentinische-halbinsel:" && ls dist/de-de/strande/sorrentinische-halbinsel/ &&
echo "" &&
echo "=== Source files ===" &&
ls src/pages/de-de/strande/)

Bash(echo "=== Verify spiaggia-di-ieranto location ===" &&
ls dist/de-de/strande/sorrentiner-halbinsel/ && 
echo "" &&
echo "Checking hreflang in the page:" &&
grep "de-de/strande/sorrentiner-halbinsel/spiaggia" dist/de-de/strande/sorrentiner-halbinsel/spiaggia-di-ieranto/index.html | head -1 && echo "✓ Correct path in hreflang")

Bash(echo "=== Finding German URL typos ===" &&
grep -n "de-de.*anfahrt\\|de-de.*straende\\|de-de.*spiagge\\|de-de.*quando\\|de-de/amalfikueste/capri\\|de-de/amalfikueste/sorrento" src/components/Header.astro src/components/Footer.astro | head -20)

Bash(echo "=== Searching all de-de pages for wrong URLs ===" &&
grep -r "anfahrt\\|straende\\|quando-visitare\\|/it-it/positano" src/pages/de-de --include="*.astro" | grep href | head -15)

Bash(echo "=== All wrong URLs in de-de pages ===" &&
grep -r "/de-de/quando-visitare\\|/de-de/anfahrt\\|/de-de/straende\\|/de-de/amalfikueste/capri\\|/de-de/amalfikueste/sorrento\\|/it-it/positano" src/pages/de-de --include="*.astro" | grep -o "href=\\"[^\\"]*\\"" | sort -u)

Bash(echo "=== Searching for capri, sorrento, positano links ===" &&
grep -rn "amalfikueste/capri\\|amalfikueste/sorrento\\|it-it/positano" src/pages/de-de --include="*.astro" | grep href | head -10)
